title: Care Desk Correction Limits for Community Solar Subscriptions
content:
Two plan terms of Community Solar Subscriptions bound the correction of invoice lines: how long after posting a line may still be corrected, and the largest rebill credit a care agent may post on one line.

| Plan | Months after posting during which a line may be corrected | Largest rebill credit a care agent may post on one line |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Flex | 12 calendar months | $100.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 1-Year | 12 calendar months | $100.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 5-Year | 12 calendar months | $100.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 10-Year | 12 calendar months | $100.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 20-Year | 12 calendar months | $100.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Income-Eligible | 12 calendar months | $100.00 |

- The correction period is counted in calendar months from the date the line was posted, and is the same 12 calendar months on every plan.
- The care agent's limit applies per line and is the same $100.00 on every plan.

*Hypothetical reading:* on any Beacon Ridge Solar Share plan, a rebill credit of $100.00 on one line is within the care agent's limit; a rebill credit of $100.01 on one line is not.
